source: Important. The same high-level equation covers many different routers. Softmax Top-ZXMATH0000XZ sigmoid-based affinity, balanced assignment, and expert-choice methods differ in howZXMATH0001XZ is constructed. The equation is the abstraction, not a specification of one implementation.
